title: astraea gardneri
intro: Astraea gardneri, commonly known as New Zealand Christmas tree, is a small, evergreen tree native to New Zealand. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Astraea gardneri include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which can be used to alleviate muscle spasms, soothe irritated skin, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Astraea gardneri include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
